mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 47 degrees with clear skies and a full moon shining over the Verona Public Library.

Important updates for your commute: a section of Hwy M near the Aldi site will be closed for road work from Monday, October 5 through Wednesday, October 7. Also, the Planning Department reminds residents to watch out for scams involving fake fee requests, as all legitimate payments should be made via check at the City Administration Building.

We have a busy schedule ahead with live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee happening today, yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness, and several trivia nights and the farmer's market coming up early next week.
In our weekly look back, officers were called on September 5 to investigate reports of cheese slices found on car windshields, which they identified as a social media prank.
Today's flavor at Culver's is Turtle, and the store will be ready to serve you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
